name: May Club 2
source:
In this story, you are a third year high school student and the son of the May Club's president.
You have experienced the May Club many times over, but now is not the time for playing anymore, because if you don't find a wife using the May Club, your promised studying abroad will go poof.
"That old man... he has too much commercial spirit to use a pretext to make his own son advertises for the company... all of that because I am missing credits after I slacked off too much..."

However, the girls are waiting for you at the May Club.
Complaining will not solve anything.
There is only one month and a half left.
You are the only one able to make the girls happy.
If you do your best and clear all the obstacles in front of you, what is waiting for you is...

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20000305145943/http://www.excellents.co.jp/desire/mayclub2/data.html]official website[/url]]
